pairs.name: halftone
pairs.alt: The dancer on a dark stage, original left and with Halftone right: her dress and arms turn into a grid of round dark dots on pale paper, large in the shadows and small in the light, and the stage becomes almost solid dark ink
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Halftone at its default settings.

pairs.name: dither
pairs.alt: The dancer's face, shoulders and raised arm, original left and with Dithering right: skin, hair and dress turn into a fine checked pattern of a few flat colours, and the dark stage behind her becomes black with sparse grey and red pixels
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Dithering at its default settings, a detail at twice the size.

pairs.name: riso
pairs.alt: The dancer's face, raised arm and dress on a dark stage, original left and with Riso right: the stage becomes deep indigo where both inks overlap, her skin turns into pink dots, the shadows of her dress into blue dots, and the light parts of the dress stay cream paper
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Riso at its default settings, a detail.

pairs.name: riso-glow
pairs.alt: The dancer and the lamp on a dark stage, original left and with Riso Glow right: a print of pink and indigo dots on a deep plum ground, where her skin, dress and the lamp give off a soft pink glow
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Riso Glow at its default settings, at the top of its pulse.

pairs.name: paper-print
pairs.alt: The dancer on a dark stage, original left and with Paper Print right: the picture becomes a print in warm black ink on cream paper, made of a fine grain that gathers densely in the shadows and thins out in her lit dress, with tiny specks of paper in the solid black stage
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Paper Print at its default settings, at full size.
